properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure AD B2C: Audit MFA Enablement in User Flows
properties.description: Audits that multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled in Azure AD B2C user flows and custom policies. FedRAMP High requires MFA for all interactive authentication per IA-2(1). B2C MFA is configured through user flow settings or custom policy XML — this audit policy verifies compliance tagging on the B2C directory resource.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance when MFA enablement tag is missing. Disabled: Do not evaluate. Note: B2C MFA enforcement is managed via user flow settings or custom policy XML, not Azure resource policy. Deny effect is not applicable.
